applies_why: The judge text does not count a cited verse as an unanswered witness or toward a broken link; it says the row was answered and that neither chain forces the other.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: 'counts as an unanswered witness' versus 'UNDERDETERMINED/answered' — I weighed whether the judge's entry counts Acts 2:30 as an unanswered witness (which would require a quoted pressing sentence and named round) or instead treats the row as answered/stalemated (so no such count).
why: The judge text says the row was answered and that neither chain forces the other, so it does not count Acts 2:30 toward a broken link or as an unanswered witness, and K-G4 is not triggered.
